run_prep_msmarco_train: run the cli tool to prepare msmarco train and dev jsonl files from query and triples files
run_read_query: run the read_query function to parse a tsv file of query ids and queries into a dictionary
build_msmarco_train_dev_split: build a train and dev split of msmarco data from query and qidpid triples files
refactor_read_query: refactor the read_query function to support additional delimiters or file formats
review_main: review the main function to understand how msmarco train and dev jsonl files are generated
